searchText: Corresponding issue here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/2096 CC <@425572898787426305> for thoughts here If execution-specs was extended to also support `engine_newPayload`, then it may require coordination since we would want them to both be in sync (unless we deprecate it in `execution-apis`)
